title: Congratulations to the SDSE 2026 Poster Award Team!
summary: Congratulations to Iqra Shaheen and our collaborators on receiving an Honorable Mention poster award at SDSE 2026 for our work on vanadium redox flow battery electrodes!
paragraphs: Congratulations to Iqra Shaheen and our collaborators on receiving an Honorable Mention poster award at SDSE 2026!

Our poster, “Nanostructured g-C3N4-Decorated Graphite Felt Electrodes for Enhanced Redox Kinetics in Vanadium Redox Flow Batteries,” was presented at the 4th International Conference on Smart Devices and Sustainable Energy in New Taipei City, Taiwan, on 14–16 October 2026.
This work was a collaboration among Iqra Shaheen, Yu-Xian Lee, Wei-Hao Chiu, Shih-Hsuan Chen, and Kun-Mu Lee. Congratulations to everyone involved!
